title: Smoother conversations and easier sharing
summary: This update improves reading position, attachment sharing, and notification reliability across Shadow Chat.

sections.heading: Keep your place
items: General Chat, DMs, reply threads, and Pins discussions restore unread conversations more reliably, including messages beyond the latest page.
Loading history and receiving new messages preserve your reading position. Jump to latest brings you back when you are ready.
Opening a pinned General message takes you to its conversation context.

sections.heading: Paste, preview, and send
items: Paste images or files into the composer, or drag files in on desktop. Review your selections before sending.
Attachment progress, cancellation, and retry make interrupted uploads easier to handle.
Pins discussions support private file attachments alongside comments.

sections.heading: Quieter, more dependable updates
items: Push notifications respect preview privacy and conversation mute settings during retries.
A failed delivery on one device can retry without repeating successful deliveries on another.
Chat loading and background refreshes do less unnecessary work. Restart when convenient to load the update.
